# Cosmic Dodge

Control a ship that constantly moves forward in a starfield. Click or tap to thrust upward; gravity pulls the ship down. Random asteroids scroll from the right. The game ends when the ship collides with an asteroid or falls off the bottom. Score equals time survived.

1: // Enhanced graphics for "Cosmic Dodge" game.
2: // Canvas with id="game" is assumed to exist in the HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   // Audio setup using Web Audio API
5:   const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
6:   const audioCtx = new AudioContext();
7:   // Ensure AudioContext is resumed on first user interaction
8:   const resumeAudio = () => { if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume(); };
9: 
10:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
11:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
12:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
13: 
14:   // Create space background gradient (dark -> slightly lighter)
15:   const bgGradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
16:   bgGradient.addColorStop(0, '#001');
17:   bgGradient.addColorStop(1, '#000');
18:   // Start ambient hum after context is ready
19:   startBackgroundHum();
20: 
21:   // Game state
22:   let lastTime = 0;
23:   let elapsed = 0;
24:   let running = true;
25:   let gameOverPlayed = false;
26:   // Ship definition (simple triangle)
27:   const ship = {
28:     x: 80,
29:     y: height / 2,
30:     vy: 0,
31:     radius: 12,
32:     thrust: -0.6,
33:     gravity: 0.02,
34:     draw() {
35:       // Ship as a gradient-filled triangle for depth
36:       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x - 15, this.y - 12, this.x, this.y + 12);
37:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#0ff');
38:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#004');
39:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
40:       ctx.beginPath();
41:       ctx.moveTo(this.x, this.y);
42:       ctx.lineTo(this.x - 15, this.y + 12);
43:       ctx.lineTo(this.x - 15, this.y - 12);
44:       ctx.closePath();
45:       ctx.fill();
46:     },
47:     update(dt) {
48:       this.vy += this.gravity * dt;
49:       this.y += this.vy * dt;
50:       // Keep within bounds (top wrap disabled, bottom ends game)
51:       if (this.y > height) running = false;
52:     }
53:   };
54: 
55:   // Input: click / tap thrust upward
56:   const thrust = () => {
57:     // Ensure audio context is running
58:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
59:     ship.vy = ship.thrust;
60:     ship.thrusting = true;
61:     // Play thrust sound
62:     playThrust();
63:     // Reset thrust visual after short delay
64:     setTimeout(() => ship.thrusting = false, 100);
65:   };
66:   canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', thrust);
67:   canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { e.preventDefault(); thrust(); });
68: 
69:   // Stars background
70:   const stars = Array.from({ length: 120 }, () => {
71:     const baseR = Math.random() * 2 + 0.5;
72:     return {
73:       x: Math.random() * width,
74:       y: Math.random() * height,
75:       r: baseR,
76:       baseR,
77:       twinkle: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
78:       speed: Math.random() * 0.3 + 0.1
79:     };
80:   });
81:   const updateStars = dt => {
82:     for (const s of stars) {
83:       s.x -= s.speed * dt;
84:       if (s.x < 0) {
85:         s.x = width;
86:         s.y = Math.random() * height;
87:       }
88:     }
89:   };
90:   const drawStars = () => {
91:     for (const s of stars) {
92:       // Twinkling effect using sine wave based on elapsed time
93:       const twinkleRadius = s.baseR + Math.sin(elapsed / 200 + s.twinkle) * 0.5;
94:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
95:       ctx.beginPath();
96:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, Math.max(0.2, twinkleRadius), 0, Math.PI * 2);
97:       ctx.fill();
98:     }
99:   };
100: 
101:   // Asteroids
102:   const asteroids = [];
103:   const asteroidSpawnInterval = 2000; // ms
104:   let nextAsteroid = asteroidSpawnInterval;
105:   const spawnAsteroid = () => {
106:     const radius = Math.random() * 20 + 10;
107:     asteroids.push({
108:       x: width + radius,
109:       y: Math.random() * (height - radius * 2) + radius,
110:       r: radius,
111:       speed: Math.random() * 0.1 + 0.05
112:     });
113:   };
114:   const updateAsteroids = dt => {
115:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
116:       const a = asteroids[i];
117:       a.x -= a.speed * dt;
118:       if (a.x + a.r < 0) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
119:     }
120:   };
121:   const drawAsteroids = () => {
122:     ctx.fillStyle = '#a52a2a';
123:     for (const a of asteroids) {
124:       ctx.beginPath();
125:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
126:       ctx.fill();
127:     }
128:   };
129: 
130:   // Collision detection
131:   const checkCollision = () => {
132:     for (const a of asteroids) {
133:       const dx = a.x - ship.x;
134:       const dy = a.y - ship.y;
135:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
136:       if (dist < a.r + ship.radius) return true;
137:     }
138:     return false;
139:   };
140: 
141:   // Score display
142:   const drawScore = () => {
143:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
144:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
145:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(elapsed / 1000), 10, 20);
146:   };
147: 
148:   // Main loop
149:   const loop = timestamp => {
150:     if (!lastTime) lastTime = timestamp;
151:     const dt = (timestamp - lastTime) * 0.06; // speed factor
152:     lastTime = timestamp;
153:     if (!running) {
154:       // Play crash sound once
155:       if (!gameOverPlayed) {
156:         playCrash();
157:         stopBackgroundHum();
158:         gameOverPlayed = true;
159:       }
160:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
161:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
162:       ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
163:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
164:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2 - 60, height / 2);
165:       drawScore();
166:       return;
167:     }
168:     elapsed += dt;
169: 
170:     // Update
171:     ship.update(dt);
172:     updateStars(dt);
173:     updateAsteroids(dt);
174:     nextAsteroid -= dt;
175:     if (nextAsteroid <= 0) { spawnAsteroid(); nextAsteroid = asteroidSpawnInterval; }
176:     if (checkCollision()) running = false;
177: 
178:     // Render
179:     // Draw space background gradient
180:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGradient;
181:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
182:     drawStars();
183:     ship.draw();
184:     drawAsteroids();
185:     drawScore();
186: 
187:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
188:   };

191: })();
